notes:
PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked); no hardware was attached and no hardware or upstream sim-engine run is claimed. The card entry symbol was confirmed in the read-only clone: ksim/mjx_gym/envs/stompy_env/stompy.py:21 defines class StompyEnv(PipelineEnv); ksim/mjx_gym/envs/__init__.py:9 maps the name stompy to it and :12-14 registers it with brax; :33 builds its MJCF path as MODEL_DIR + /stompy/stompy.xml and :34 loads it with mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path. The card's family-config / mujoco / MujocoDriver decision is used as given, with no deviation: the card's models list names ksim/assets/unitree_h1/scene.xml first and also ksim/assets/stompy/stompy.xml; this package serves the latter because it is the file the confirmed StompyEnv entry loads (stompy.py:33), through the MuJoCo bridge. The served interface is the raw cap.world.step.v1 / cap.world.reset.v1 contract of the model: 31 motor actuators with ctrllimited true and ctrlrange -200 200 (stompy.xml:230-262), an unactuated root made of three slide joints and one ball joint (stompy.xml:61-64), 38 qpos and 37 qvel values, and the model's own 0.001 s timestep (stompy.xml:16). The upstream environment layer is NOT reimplemented: StompyEnv's keyframe-default initial qpos plus uniform reset noise, reward function, 1 - is_healthy termination, observation assembly and four-physics-step control period (stompy.py:41) stay upstream, and the fidelity gaps name them. The reset capability runs mj_resetData + mj_forward and restores the model defaults; the bridge publishes no seed control for this engine, so the reset receipt reports seed 0 and cap.world.seed.v1 is not served. MuJoCo and the JAX/MJX stack were not importable where the gate ran (no network, no pip), so backends['fake'] is this package's stand-in mujoco module in fake.py. The stand-in parses the same MJCF (root slide/ball joints, 27 hinge joints, four finger slide joints, 31 motor ctrlranges, option timestep) and implements MjModel.from_xml_path, MjData, mj_resetData, mj_forward and mj_step, but its dynamics are a placeholder: no meshes, inertia, contact, friction, constraint, damping, armature or actuator model, and it does not implement mj_getState/mj_setState, so the bridge's documented basic checkpoint profile is used and snapshot_restore is declared false. The real mujoco backend (an unlisted backend name, which imports the real library) was not run and requires deployment validation. The world state is the bridge's time_ms, qpos, qvel, ctrl, tick, timestep_ms, seed and native_checkpoint; the test suite exercises the adapter through the stock server. WARNINGS KEPT from the last gate run, all explained: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND because the fake is a stand-in module for the mujoco library rather than a fake class the gate can wrap in its Recorder (the same expected MuJoCo-family warning as the other MuJoCo-family packages); G8.NO_UNIT x3 for the bridge-derived inputs seed, action.ctrl[*] and ticks. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was raised. TESTS: test_driver.py keeps mhs.testing.check_driver(HERE, backend='fake') and adds eight cases (world shape and basic checkpoint profile, control application and model-time advance, ctrlrange refusal with zero effect, wrong control count rejected before the engine, reset to model defaults with the documented seed behavior, repeatability of the stand-in, published fidelity contract, e-stop latch with readable state); all pass. No catalogue_requests: only cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 are used. No site-limits.example.json is needed: the package declares no Limit and the control envelope is derived from the model, so there is no operator-required bound. driver.lock.json keeps the pinned upstream commit and install block, names the fake entry .fake:FakeMujoco, and records authored_by kind model (deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run retriage-drivers-1-057) with reviewed_by null; no human review, hardware run or safety certification is claimed. The read-only upstream clone was read in place, never imported, installed or modified.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Reviewed the pinned Stompy entry, MJCF actuator order and control ranges, fake, stop/reset path and provenance as an R0 raw-model contract. In driver.py, narrowed the root, force and keyframe facts, disclosed omitted solver overrides and retained controls, and set the fake backend to analytic:stompy/F0; test_driver.py now asserts that fidelity. Synchronized facts.md and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The fake gate, package tests and strict collector pass; evidence remains contract_checked. For the human reviewer: This serves the raw Stompy MJCF, not StompyEnv reward/reset/observation semantics or MJX solver/control-period settings. The F0 fake has no physical dynamics, and no upstream code or real simulator was run. E-stop halts bridge-owned lockstep integration while retaining velocities and controls; latch reset advances nothing, and a subsequent step without action reuses retained controls.
